allocation.authority: User selected equal initial component capital on 2026-11-05
allocation.external_flows: forbidden_within_cohort; any occurrence blocks comparability and requires separately registered flow treatment
allocation.idle_cash: Retained in the originating component; no interest assumed; included in all totals
allocation.rounding: Weights and notional allocations are exact rational quantities, never six rounded decimal weights. Keep any venue-sized order remainder as originating-component USDT cash; no remainder is dropped or swept to another component.
allocation.initial_funding: Capital is unknown. The research subledger partition is exactly C/6 each, not six physical transfers. If actual account funding cannot support this partition, block; do not silently round starting weights.
allocation.quantity_between_fills: Constant, including base dust. Only reconciled actual fills or separately recorded actual-currency costs can change quantities.
allocation.reentry: Use only that component's then-available cash, including retained sale proceeds and dust, so each component compounds independently. No target-weight restoration.

signals.entry: completed close > max preceding entry-lookback highs, excluding signal bar
signals.exit: completed close < min preceding exit-lookback lows, excluding signal bar
signals.equality: retain signal target; no new instruction on equality alone
signals.initial_state: all six flat at common development start after 100 full warmup bars; do not reconstruct prior holdings
signals.availability: both event_time and independently demonstrated available_at must be strictly before next-day 00:05:00 UTC; later retrieval proves contents only
signals.missing_bar: block, never shorten warmup or lookback

execution.policy_authority: Explicit public research planning assumptions, no live execution authority
execution.quote_selection: earliest valid sequenced two-sided executable quote in interval; buy ask, sell bid; incremental impact separately locked and not double counted
execution.retry_policy: At most one instruction per component per decision. Cancel any unfilled remainder at the deadline. No intra-window retry or same-decision reentry. A fresh entry condition retries only if actual base quantity is exactly zero; a positive partial entry or dust suppresses topping up. A fresh exit condition retries if actual base quantity is positive. Neither condition means no new order even when signal target and actual state differ. No daily retry on equality/hold days. Terminal close is a separate one-attempt override for all actual residual quantities.
execution.unknown_outcome: Do not infer zero or full fill from an observed quote. Missing reconciliation blocks subsequent actual-state reconstruction and ending validity. Retain all threshold candidate windows plus all six terminal candidates until outcomes are known.
execution.entry_sizing: Largest permitted rounded-down base order whose worst permitted consideration plus all quote-denominated fees is <= the component's available USDT, with all other fee currencies funded from that component's existing balances. Fee-inclusive, fully paid. Capital, instrument filters, fee basis and incremental impact remain blockers. Base-charged entry fee reduces gross acquired base quantity. Unspent USDT is retained.
execution.exit_sizing: Largest permitted sell quantity whose sold base plus base-denominated fee is <= actual base balance. Quote fee debits proceeds/cash once. Precision/minimum failure creates no fill and retains dust and cash. Residual base is still owned.
execution.errors: Absent/invalid quote, unknown available_at, insufficient depth, unknown precision/fee/impact, rejection or failed minimum-size check does not create a fill. Partial fills apply only reconciled amounts. Missing or conflicting outcome blocks the ledger rather than fabricating flatness.

accounting.balances: Independent nonnegative cash/base/other actual cost-currency balances for each component; aggregate by symbol then portfolio; no sharing, leverage, shorting or external rescue
accounting.costs: Unique actual event identifiers prevent duplicate charging. Debit each fee once in its actual currency; quote fees reduce USDT, base fees reduce base, third-currency fees require funded owned balances and independent currency marks. Spread already in bid/ask is not another additive fee. Impact is not charged twice. Unpriced actual costs block complete accounting; unknown costs are not zero.
accounting.capital_denominator: All initial capital and all owned cash, holdings and dust, including idle components. No financing/collateral 40/40/20 split.
accounting.valuation_formula: Per-component USDT units = USDT cash + net base quantity * fresh spot bid + independently converted owned other-currency balances; portfolio is component sum. USD = portfolio USDT units * same independent USDT/USD mark used for B0. This planner never evaluates the formula or computes returns.
accounting.b0: Hold identical initial number of USDT units with no interest assumption; same opening/daily/closing independent USDT/USD source and timestamp. Custody risk is separately disclosed. No USDT=USD=1 assumption.

valuation.policy_authority: Explicit public research planning assumption: conservative bid mark, not liquidation proceeds
valuation.spot: Freshest valid preceding spot bid; a bid mark does not include future sale fees, guarantee available depth, or prove executable liquidation
valuation.token: Freshest valid preceding independent USDT/USD mark shared with B0; independent provider and method unresolved
valuation.coverage: Every UTC midnight from first decision day through day after terminal decision, inclusive; conservative BTC/ETH spot and USDT/USD requirements even on conditionally flat days
valuation.availability: Valuation event timestamp must be in the preceding interval and demonstrated available_at must be strictly before valuation; unknown availability blocks valid historical valuation
valuation.holes: Each missing/unknown mark remains an explicit invalid valuation point. No forward-fill, day deletion, stale mark or exposure erasure. Same rule after failed terminal close.

terminal.authority: User selected terminal close with exit costs on 2026-11-05
terminal.decision: next UTC day after final included normal decision at 00:05:00
terminal.closing_valuation: following UTC midnight, strictly after terminal deadline
terminal.flatness: All actual base balances, including dust, must be zero and all fills/fees reconciled. Missing outcome, failed sale, partial sale or untradeable dust makes terminal close blocked/unresolved, never successfully liquidated.
terminal.continuation: If unresolved, retain exposure and require daily spot/token marks after planned closing valuation until separately authorized resolution. No automatic retry, extension of executable window, stale valuation or return-series truncation. The planner declares this unbounded conditional data obligation without inventing a successful endpoint.

evidence.quote_observation: Saved prefix-replay report only; raw archive hashes recorded, not rehashed by this service
evidence.archive_integrity: Upstream reports full ZIP CRC and digest receipts; this planner validates the saved report identity, not raw local archive presence
